assessments.reasoning: The survey records member-to-member relationships through individual pointer variables (mother's ID in e.23, father's ID in e.24, and partner's ID in e.25). Extended ties beyond spouse and parent-child are identified in e.22 (grandchild, siblings, non-kin) and e.26 (same-sex unions). Criteria for separating multiple households within a dwelling are explicitly based on sharing a common food budget (c.14). Sub-units (secondary family nuclei) can be identified via the parental and spousal pointer variables. Caregiving relationships (who specifically cares for whom inside or across households) are not recorded; questions d.16 and d.17 only ask if the household pays or receives external unpaid help for domestic work or care.
